C1347.title: Perplexity AI Launches Comet AI Browser to Challenge Google Chrome
C1347.summary: AI search company Perplexity AI launched the Comet AI browser in 2025, integrating an AI search engine that directly generates precise answers with citations, challenging the traditional browser market. Despite its powerful features, the internal decision-making logic of such AI-native browsers remains an opaque 'black box' for users when automatically generating answers and executing actions. Use
